column1: # open-agent-robot — python files with a `__main__` block that are NOT runner nodes.
# infra/check_deploy.sh treats every `if __name__ == "__main__":` file in the tree
# as something that is supposed to be launched by infra/run_ec2.sh. That is the
# check which would have caught the `yue` defect at its source: speech/yue_server.py
# was a complete, working entrypoint that nothing in the repo ever started.
# A file listed here is exempt — but the exemption is a reviewable line with a
# stated reason, not a comment in the guard about where it need not look. Two
# further rules keep the list honest: a listed file that the runner DOES launch is
# a finding (contradictory declaration), and a listed file that no longer exists
# is a finding (stale exemption that would silently cover its replacement).

one-off day-0 measurement script, run by hand on the instance
one-off T-I1 token measurement against Bedrock, run by hand; its result is pasted into tests/test_skills_loader.py

redaction scan over an explicit push file list, run by hand before every Git Data API push; three exit codes (0/1/3) and tested by tests/test_redact_scan.py

cross-checks the case counts quoted in docs/test-design.md and both READMEs against pytest --collect-only, run by hand before a push; three exit codes (0 agree / 1 findings / 3 cannot check) and tested by tests/test_doc_counts.py
library imported by tests/test_entrypoints.py; its __main__ is the CLI that check 8 of this very guard consumes, so it is launched by the guard rather than by the runner

the T-E3 browser walk-through's stub gateway (L5, §6.3), run by hand; never deployed. It lives here rather than under tests/ because tests/test_meta.py forbids a network import there and infra/entrypoints.py skips that directory, so a server parked in tests/ would be invisible to this very check
the Git Data API pusher for this repo's never-git-push rule, run by hand with --base/--branch; developer tooling that is never deployed to the instance, and tested by tests/test_push_branch.py

the T-G4 red-team runner over tests/fixtures/redteam.jsonl, run by hand on the instance with --guardrail-id; writes docs/evidence/s7/redteam.json and has four exit codes (0 all enforced blocked and nothing unenforced / 1 an escape past an existing enforcer / 2 well-formed but cannot claim coverage / 3 cannot run), tested by tests/test_output_guard.py

the T-F6 ablation runner over memory/rank.py's three arms, run by hand with --root/--queries; writes docs/evidence/s6/rank-ablation.json and has four exit codes (0 concluded / 1 malformed / 2 well-formed but no labels / 3 cannot run), tested by tests/test_rank.py

regenerates docs/architecture.svg from the census, run by hand before a push; three exit codes (0 wrote / 1 geometry findings / 3 the census could not run) and tested by tests/test_architecture.py, which rebuilds and compares the committed SVG byte for byte

derives every python seam only pytest reaches and checks it against infra/dormant_seams.tsv in both directions, run by hand before a push; three exit codes (0 agree / 1 findings / 3 the census could not be trusted) and tested by tests/test_wiring_census.py. It has a row in dormant_seams.tsv too, because it reads its own source like every other file in the tree
